unit: WF4 Approval Gate marks a draft STALE when its content_hash no longer matches the approval token
description: A decision that names an approval whose token_hash_or_reference no longer matches the draft's current content_hash must return gate STALE: the draft changed after the approval was raised, so the approval is void and a new one is required. No delivery identity is emitted.
why_it_exists: Gate check step 4 of wf4/approval-gate.js is the hash tie between the approval raised at decision time and the draft as it stands now. A draft edited after approval is exactly the incident the guard exists for, and the delivery-key families never exercised it because they always kept the hashes in agreement. This pins that a content change invalidates the standing approval as STALE and never sends.

drafts.content: Our client requires the vehicle inspection report referred to in your letter dated 14 January.

gate_reason_contains: changed after I raised this approval
expect.note: The approval token records the draft as it was when raised (CH-0f...); the draft now carries CH-9b..., so the content changed after the approval and the standing approval is void.

assertions: a draft whose content_hash differs from the approval token returns gate STALE
the refusal explicitly voids the approval and demands a new one, so the owner is not invited to send
dry_run is normalised to the boolean true and passed through on the refusal
Config keys survive the refusal untouched
no delivery identity is emitted on a refusal path that stopped before the derivation block
